notes: v667 - the first step in making loading faster. Share history is now fetched from your OWN server in batches of up to 200 at a time, instead of one request per share through a public relay. Your server has held the daily bars back to 2023 all along; the app simply was not asking it. Anything the server does not have is still fetched the old way, so a gap becomes a slower share rather than a share with no history - which would quietly change its technicals and its score. This version covers the technicals pass. The main market download still uses the old per-share route and is the bigger job; it is next. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
